prompt: Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One round striped watermelon with five broad unfilled stripe areas and a single crescent slice leaning beside it, clearly visible red-flesh area left white. Final line-work constraint: clean coloring-page contours, empty uniformly white interiors, no gray fill or highlights, no fine repeated texture. Medium complexity comes from a few meaningful structures, never shading.
